inputs.name: hand over from Risk Assessment to Acceptance Criteria

output.level_0: The handover is broken, and no one knows which risk maps to which acceptance criterion.
output.level_1: No process exists to connect risk assessment findings to specific acceptance criteria for the team.
output.level_2: A project manager manually maps each identified risk to an acceptance criterion in a shared spreadsheet.
output.level_4: A formal sign off confirms that every risk assessment finding has a matching acceptance criterion.
